data.description: Double Unit | Luxury Waterfront | Vacant | Burj Khalifa View
data.long_description:
Experience an extraordinary level of luxury and exclusivity in this one-of-a-kind full-floor residence at Volante Tower, Business Bay. Created by combining two half-floor units into a single expansive home, this exceptional property offers an impressive 5049 sq. ft. of meticulously designed living space with breathtaking waterfront and city views.


  Designed for discerning homeowners seeking privacy, space, and sophistication, the residence features four spacious bedrooms, including two master suites with exceptionally large walk-in wardrobes. The property also includes a dedicated maid’s room, private office, cinema room, and two kitchens, making it ideal for both family living and entertaining on a grand scale.


  Property Details:


  • Full-floor residence created by combining two half-floor units
  • Size: 5049 sq. ft.
  • 4 Bedrooms (2 Bedrooms with huge walk-in wardrobes)
  • Maid’s Room
  • Private Office
  • Dedicated Cinema Room
  • 2 Kitchens
  • Expansive Living and Dining Areas
  • Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
  • Premium Finishes Throughout
  • Exceptional Natural Light
  • Stunning Canal and Skyline Views


  Amenities:


  • Infinity Swimming Pool
  • Fully Equipped Gymnasium
  • Luxury Spa and Wellness Facilities
  • Private Residents’ Lounge
  • 24/7 Concierge Service
  • High-Speed Elevators
  • Covered Parking
  • Advanced Security and CCTV Monitoring
  • Exclusive Waterfront Lifestyle


  Location Highlights:


  • Prime waterfront location in Business Bay
  • Direct access to Dubai Water Canal
  • Minutes from Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa
  • Easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road
  • Close to Dubai Mall, DIFC, and City Walk
  • Surrounded by luxury retail, fine dining, and entertainment venues


  This remarkable residence represents a rare opportunity to own one of the largest and most exclusive homes in Volante Tower. Offering the privacy of a full-floor layout, exceptional amenities, and a prestigious Business Bay address, it is truly a trophy property in the heart of Dubai.
